limitations: Raw X11 black area outside the app window is desktop canvas.
Internal preview overflow and editor viewport overflow are distinguished; static partial visibility does not prove scrolling reachability.
No product/test/original-image edits or UI actions by reviewer.

findings: Root mathematics, 2 by 2 matrices, footnote references and definition/return links are legible in all reviewed target shots.
Flow completion geometry is partial at 150 narrow and 200 both widths.
Sequence messages are legible at 150 narrow but lower lifeline tails extend below the visible boundary; 200 narrow also hides the return message.

Pie lower circle is partial except at 100/125 wide; percentage suffixes are outside the right preview boundary at 150 narrow and 200 wide, and the entire legend is outside the horizontal viewport at 200 narrow.
Both themes exhibit the same partial-visibility boundaries. Eight WebView comparisons match their corresponding X11 application pixels.
summary.scopeNote: wholeTargetVisible concerns drawn target content, not empty SVG viewBox padding or the surrounding SAMPLE marker. No scrolling interaction or whole-product acceptance is inferred.
